title: 2014 - Wi-Fi.HK
author: hkwtia
plainText: WTIA and Office of the Government Chief Information Officer (OGCIO) launched Wi-Fi.HK, a common Wi-Fi brand established to facilitate the public and visitors in locating and accessing the free public Wi-Fi services in Hong Kong. With the support from both public and private sectors, there are over 12,000 hotspots under the brand to provide easy access of free Wi-Fi services to the public and visitors.
